CommunityApplications.Profile:
**AspireUI** — a self-hosted app platform and visual builder for container stacks.
Install apps from a built-in store of 140+ apps, deploy any `docker-compose` repository straight from Git, and manage everything that runs: logs, env vars, ports, volumes, scheduled backups, notifications and your own domains (with Let's Encrypt HTTPS through Nginx Proxy Manager). It doubles as a visual editor for .NET Aspire AppHost projects — drag resources onto a canvas, generate real C# code, run it, or publish Docker Compose.
AspireUI needs the host Docker socket, because starting and hosting other containers is what it does. That is root-equivalent access to the server, so run it on a machine you trust and keep its port off the public internet.
Support: https://github.com/fgilde/AspireUI/issues
